name: ARA-EXP-PRE-003
title: Invalid pack chunk size
summary: The preset's chunkSize is outside the supported range of 1 through 16,777,216 bytes. Export stops at preset validation.
html:
The preset's chunkSize is outside the supported range of 1 through 16,777,216 bytes. Export stops at preset validation.

#Common causes

  • chunkSize is zero or greater than 16 MiB.

#Fixes

  • Use chunkSize: 1048576 for 1 MiB chunks, or another byte count in the allowed range.

  • Code: ARA-EXP-PRE-003 (slot 8010)

  • Constant: export::PRE_003

  • Reported by: ara-export
